data.why: JALEBI bundles real JWST/MIRI FZ Tau x1d FITS files, HV Tau C s3d cube cutouts, and synthetic spectra inside src/jalebi/example_data/, which ships inside the installed package, so the Source page's --data-root can point straight at it and nothing needs to be copied or synthesized.

goals: open the bundled FZ Tau JWST/MIRI spectrum and fit its continuum with one of the seven methods
add molecular slab components (H2O, CO2, HCN, CO, etc.), drag log N / T / log R sliders and watch the model update live
run automatic molecule detection to see which species are present above the detection threshold
run a quick grid + optimiser fit and then a short MCMC run and inspect the posterior (corner plot, summary table, tau flags)
open the bundled HV Tau C IFU cube, make a line/velocity map, click a spaxel for its Gaussian fit, and extract a region spectrum
fit a rotation diagram (H2, CO, OH or H2O) on a spectrum and read off temperature, column density and ortho/para ratio

review.summary: The tree follows JALEBI's main stages: continuum, live slab model, grid map, molecule detection, staged grid→DE→MCMC, rotation diagrams and cube maps. The sampled screens back its claims, and features f1–f4 are clean, replayed components. It needs fixing before filing because the step the README puts at the centre, inspecting the joint posterior and its degeneracies, is missing, detection never feeds a joint fit, and cube region extraction is absent; nearly half the tasks were never replayed.
